assignmentStatusHints.accepting: The due date has not passed yet. Students can still turn in this assignment on time.
assignmentStatusHints.acceptingLate: The due date has passed, but the assignment is still open, so late work can still be turned in.
assignmentStatusHints.completed: This assignment is closed in Classroom and is no longer accepting submissions.

statusHints.returned: The teacher returned the work to the student with a grade.
statusHints.returnedUngraded: The teacher returned the work with a grade of 0 (or with no score).
statusHints.turnedIn: The student submitted the work and it is waiting for review.
statusHints.assigned: The assignment was given to the student, but they have not submitted it yet.
statusHints.noAccess: The student has never opened this assignment. This includes students who joined the class after it was posted.
statusHints.reclaimed: The student turned the work in and then unsubmitted it, so it is back in their hands.

flagHints.late: This submission was turned in after the due date.
flagHints.pastDue: The due date has already passed and nothing was submitted.
flagHints.pastDueStillOpen: The due date has passed and this student has not submitted. Late work may still be accepted because the assignment is still open.
flagHints.pastDueClosed: The due date has passed, nothing was submitted, and this assignment is no longer accepting work.
flagHints.resubmitted: The student edited their submission after turning it in.
flagHints.draft: The teacher has saved a draft grade that has not been assigned yet.
